psychological_meaning: Jet Stream evokes a sense of calm and tranquility, reminiscent of a gentle breeze and open skies. It promotes feelings of peace, clarity, and gentle optimism. This color is often associated with mental relaxation and a refreshing outlook, creating a soothing and serene environment.
